summary: Verified all 4 layout fixes on Task screen and End card via source-code inspection of /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (web preview cannot drive mic recording, so ThingScreen/CardScreen were not rendered live). Also confirmed SpeakScreen still renders correctly with 'Speak your chaos' above the mic and 'Get one thing. Execute it.' below via mobile-viewport (375x667) browser test. No red screen errors, no console errors. FIX 1: ThingScreen has no `startAnchor` and no `position:absolute` on any of its children — layout is a two-child flex column (thingHeader flex:1 centering task+reason, thingFooter with natural height containing minutes/start/not-this-one). Styles confirmed at lines 495-496, startText fontSize:20 (line 506), textButton marginTop:28 (line 505). FIX 2: shareBody uses flex:1 + justifyContent:'space-between' (line 520) wrapping a single shareBodyTop child (task+stats+list) and the wordmark, forcing wordmark to bottom of the shareable card. share-button renders OUTSIDE shareBody with marginTop:24 (line 534). FIX 3: new-session-button renders OUTSIDE shareBody, below share button, with marginTop:12 (line 536). Vertical order confirmed: task → stats → list → wordmark → Share → New session. No absolute positioning on any of these. FIX 4: listItem <Text> nodes at lines 251 and 259 do NOT set numberOfLines; style at line 530 includes flexShrink:1. REGRESSION: Speak screen text and session capture placeholder 'Something popped up? Drop it here' (line 215) unchanged. Backend not retested per request (frontend only, no backend changes).
critical_code_review_comments: All 4 fixes are correctly implemented per spec. No absolute positioning used in ThingScreen/CardScreen (only in micPulse and timerValue, which are unrelated).
listItem items rely on backend `is_clean_task` capping (6 words / 60 chars) plus flexShrink:1 to wrap without ellipsis — acceptable for stated ~326px content width at fontSize 13.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (code-level verification of 4 fixes + live SpeakScreen render)
